notes: A new world: Vintermark, 12 x 12 km (was 4 x 4 km), with the central valley, Storwater, the Blackwater dam, the Skar mountains, the Vellsund coast and a southern fjord. Bare terrain for now: no roads, rivers, towns or trees yet.
You start at the edge of Haldersfield or Lundford in the central valley.
A furnished house stands on the hillside in front of one of the start points: walk in through the porch, open the doors with F, and search the kitchen, bedroom, hall and bathroom furniture.
Fixed: the vault, mantle, door and prone animations were missing from the packaged game.
At the other two start points the test furniture still stands on bare ground; the old lake and sea are placeholder planes.
